title: On the Twin-Court Cudgel
summary: Teaches the twin-court cudgel, in which two benches of blows sit in judgment and give one verdict.

title: Hawk Over Azure Water Club Canon
summary: Shows how a Xiantian cultivator hovers, stoops and strikes with a club like a hawk over azure water.

title: The River-Basin Club Reckoning
summary: Teaches a student to read the current of a fight and gather blows like tributaries into one flood.

title: Canon of the Dual-Track Heavy Club
summary: Gathers the heavy dual-track forms in which two rails of force run down one club and meet at its head.

title: Paired Hawks and the Cudgel
summary: Teaches the cudgel as two hawks hunting, one luring the foe and the other striking from behind.

title: The Azure Bruiser's Long Canon
summary: Sets out the long blue-sky tradition of club work, from the clear-day clout to the pressing of the heavens.

title: Treatise on the Basin-Mouth Cudgel
summary: Teaches how to narrow a fight to a single mouth, funnel the foe through it, then let all force pour out.

title: The Wind-Sworn Bruiser's Discourse
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn club forms in which a blow is the keeping of a word given to the wind.

title: On Plateau Winds and the Heavy Club
summary: Describes how a Xiantian fighter uses the open plateau's winds to shear, level and fall upon his opponent.

title: Oath of the Held Bearing Club Treatise
summary: Teaches the club as an oath held on one bearing, which no blow or storm is allowed to bend.

title: Canon of the Open Plateau Cudgel
summary: Sets out cudgel forms for open ground and long sight, where nothing stands between fighter and foe.

title: The Gale-Breaker Club Discourse
summary: Teaches a Xiantian cultivator to break the force of storms and of armed rushes with one heavy club.

title: Treatise on Bearing and Blow
summary: Joins the taking of a bearing to the club blow, so that aim and stroke are one act.

title: The Long Wind Club Canon
summary: Teaches the club forms of the long wind, which gathers steadily over distance and does not tire.
